Because the dataset contains an extreme outlier (900), the mean would be highly skewed and misrepresent the data. In this case, the median is the most statistically appropriate measure of central tendency to represent a "typical value". 

Confidence Level: 95%

```python
import statistics

def typical_value(data):
    # The median is robust to outliers, making it the best measure of a "typical" value here.
    median_val = statistics.median(data)
    return f"{median_val:.2f}"
```
